items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: that's where the first idea of me wanting to play the piano is watching Warren and Edgar.

ctx.x: In other words, when they knock off of the job, they come into your house and play until train time.

Until train time, that's correct. Now, as the year went by, Ogeet's son Edgar, played the saxophone, and Warren played clarinet and piano. And that's where the first idea of me wanting to play the piano is watching Warren and Edgar.
